description.value: Papa John's is a national pizza chain offering delivery and takeout at this Port Alberni location on Vancouver Island. Touring cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley will find a familiar option for a quick pizza order or takeout meal. The location is part of the broader chain network serving British Columbia.
